about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hi! I'm Eduardo, a Fullstack Developer passionate about technology and focused on building high-impact digital solutions.
about.p2: With a background in Software Engineering, I work end-to-end developing applications. My day-to-day involves everything from building high-conversion Landing Pages to developing complex systems such as ERPs, intelligent chatbots integrated with APIs, and automated solutions leveraging Artificial Intelligence. My main tools to bring these projects to life are React and Node.js.
about.p3: Beyond lines of code, I maintain an active and balanced routine with a fitness lifestyle, practicing weightlifting and running. I'm also a big enthusiast of games, series, movies, and music. I strongly believe that immersing myself in great stories and taking care of mind and body fuels my creativity, giving me the energy to think outside the box and solve complex problems efficiently.
